a.xlink:title: --- stage: test parallel: matrix: - RUBY_VERSION: - '2.7' - '3.0' - '3.1' - '3.2' OS: - ubuntu - alpine script: - echo "Testing on Ruby ${RUBY_VERSION} with ${OS}" - ruby --version - bundle install - bundle exec rspec

--- stage: build parallel: matrix: - PLATFORM: - linux/amd64 - linux/arm64 - linux/arm/v7 BUILD_TYPE: - release - debug script: - echo "Building for ${PLATFORM} (${BUILD_TYPE})" - docker buildx build --platform=${PLATFORM} --build-arg BUILD_TYPE=${BUILD_TYPE} -t myapp:${CI_COMMIT_SHA}-${PLATFORM//\//-}-${BUILD_TYPE} .
--- stage: build parallel: 8 script: - echo "Processing data shard ${CI_NODE_INDEX}/${CI_NODE_TOTAL}" - "./scripts/process_shard.sh ${CI_NODE_INDEX} ${CI_NODE_TOTAL}"

--- stage: deploy parallel: matrix: - PROVIDER: - aws - gcp - azure REGION: - us-east-1 - us-west-2 - eu-central-1 ENVIRONMENT: - staging - production script: - echo "Deploying to ${PROVIDER} ${REGION} (${ENVIRONMENT})" - "./scripts/deploy.sh --provider=${PROVIDER} --region=${REGION} --env=${ENVIRONMENT}" when: manual only: - main

--- stage: test parallel: matrix: - RUBY_VERSION: - '3.0' - '3.1' - '3.2' DATABASE: - postgresql - mysql - RUBY_VERSION: '2.7' DATABASE: sqlite script: - echo "Integration tests with Ruby ${RUBY_VERSION} and ${DATABASE}" - bundle exec rake db:test:prepare - bundle exec rspec spec/integration
--- stage: test parallel: 5 script: - echo "Running unit tests in parallel job ${CI_NODE_INDEX}/${CI_NODE_TOTAL}" - bundle exec rspec --tag ~integration --only-failures

--- stage: test parallel: matrix: - BROWSER: - chrome - firefox - safari BROWSER_VERSION: - latest - previous script: - echo "E2E tests on ${BROWSER} ${BROWSER_VERSION}" - npm install - npm run test:e2e -- --browser=${BROWSER} --version=${BROWSER_VERSION}
--- stage: test parallel: 10 script: - echo "Stress test instance ${CI_NODE_INDEX} of ${CI_NODE_TOTAL}" - "./scripts/stress_test.sh --instance=${CI_NODE_INDEX}"
--- stage: test parallel: matrix: - LINTER: - rubocop - reek - brakeman TARGET: - app/ - lib/ - spec/ script: - echo "Running ${LINTER} on ${TARGET}" - bundle exec ${LINTER} ${TARGET}

--- stage: test parallel: matrix: - RUBY_VERSION: - '3.0' - '3.1' - '3.2' CONCURRENCY: - 1 - 10 - 100 PAYLOAD_SIZE: - small - medium - large script: - echo "Performance test: Ruby ${RUBY_VERSION}, Concurrency ${CONCURRENCY}, Payload ${PAYLOAD_SIZE}" - bundle exec ruby scripts/performance_test.rb --concurrency=${CONCURRENCY} --payload=${PAYLOAD_SIZE}

--- stage: test parallel: matrix: - SERVICE: - api - auth - notifications - billing TEST_SUITE: - unit - integration - contract script: - echo "Testing ${SERVICE} service: ${TEST_SUITE} tests" - cd services/${SERVICE} - bundle exec rspec spec/${TEST_SUITE}
